title: Iaawu Hearth — kolapot
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint a NEW ultra-wide 25:8 panoramic character background for Omniluxia. Input reference 1 is the previous gnomish hearth painting: retain its broad matte oil brushwork, crafted stone-and-dark-timber architecture, quiet shadowed left foreground and warm magical civic hearth, but completely redesign scene and weather to make the magical shelter unmistakable. Reference 2 establishes the same gnomish architectural vocabulary and painting style only.
Lore: Iaawu Hearths are ancient magical fires gifted by Wielkopan to arctic gnomes, melting glaciers and sustaining fertile farming and large urban centers. Nookti cities and Saasamenn's hearth cities thrive through these fires. Craftsmen value artistic beauty and self-reliance.
Primary visual: a snow globe with the snow OUTSIDE. A large living green city and its surrounding farms are enclosed in a huge subtle translucent magical warmth canopy. Outside the canopy a truly severe blue-grey WHITEOUT BLIZZARD rages: dense swirling snow, long wind-driven diagonal streaks, frozen fir silhouettes half lost in white, immense snowdrifts. The snow visibly curls along and is deflected around the curved protective boundary. This contrast is the main story, clearly legible at 800x256.
View from a sheltered shaded carved timber council balcony inside the warm zone, overlooking dense terraced gnomish stone houses, workshops, bridges, slate roofs, beautifully crafted wooden details, small doors and inviting amber windows. Show a LARGE prosperous city, not a few rural cottages. Farther within the boundary show substantial productive green crop strips, orchards and leafy trees, all completely free of snow. Distinct transition from green earth to deep snow immediately beyond the protected perimeter. A magnificent ancient magical hearth burns steady golden amber in a circular carved stone civic basin in center-right plaza; it is the focal point and the source of the protective glow, not a destructive fire or volcano. Warm air and fine golden motes rise toward a faint arcing amber boundary across upper sky, transparent and organic, not solid glass, no technological grid. The canopy encloses BOTH city and farms. Its curved silhouette should be visible against storm-dark white snow outside. Main interest around 70-75 percent width so a narrow portrait crop shows hearth, city and snowy background.
Palette and mood: warm gold, earthy green and brown, sheltered calm and everyday abundance inside; fierce desaturated icy blue-grey storm outside. Interior softly illuminated by hearth and diffuse daylight through storm, no clear blue sunny sky. Left 20 percent dark and quiet for character overlay. Broad economical painted marks, broken edges, atmospheric perspective, restrained matte historical strategy game art matching reference. Keep essential shapes clear and painterly, not hyperdetailed procedural city. No snow on any interior roof, street, balcony or crops. No giant person, mushroom houses, steampunk, modern greenhouse, sci-fi forcefield grid, literal glass snow globe, Christmas ornaments, flags, text, watermark, UI. A few tiny gnomish inhabitants optional for scale, no foreground characters. Full bleed 25:8 panorama.
visual_review: Warm snow-free city and farmland beneath amber canopy; blizzard outside. Source and both native-size crops inspected. Live game rendering unverified.
